data.body: **[P1] Run terminal change hooks before releasing operation waiters.** For a terminal update, `operation.onCheckpointComplete()` has already completed the operation future before this hook runs. The resumed handler can therefore start another at-least-once step whose body runs while its START remains queued behind this checkpoint. If `onOperationChange` then reports a fatal error, the batcher drops that START and the body runs again on replay. Publish the updated snapshot and run the end/change hooks before completing operation futures, then add a blocked terminal-change hook test proving subsequent user code cannot start.
